summary: DCTCP is a TCP congestion control scheme for data centers. It builds on ECN by estimating what fraction of traffic sees congestion, and then shrinks the sending window in proportion. This keeps queues short and delay low. This informational RFC documents it rather than making it a standard.

eli5.summary: Instead of slamming the brakes at the first sign of a traffic jam, it eases off in proportion to how crowded the road is.

questions: tcp congestion control for data centers
